versions.changelog:
- Major update: Replaced XClaw agent network skill with a professional naming creative engine for brands, products, companies, people, pets, and more.
- Removed all previous XClaw-related code, documentation, and scripts.
- Introduced structured naming workflows—requirement analysis, creative generation, and intelligent optimization.
- Supports multilingual, cross-cultural name creation with in-depth analysis (semantics, culture, phonetics).
- Interactive, context-aware dialogue with iterative feedback for refined naming proposals.
- New output standards, methodology, and usage scenarios tailored for creative naming needs.

Major update: Replaced the "naming-expert" skill with a new XClaw Agent Network skill.

- Complete overhaul of skill purpose: now interfaces with the XClaw distributed AI Agent network.
- Removed legacy naming methodologies, templates, and terminology files.
- Added endpoint/API documentation and setup scripts to enable XClaw network integration.
- Introduced detailed configuration, authentication, and error handling instructions.
- The new skill supports agent search, network overview, skill marketplace browsing, agent registration, billing, reviews, messaging, and more.

- Added a workflow step for generating AI text design prompts for each naming proposal, referencing a dedicated style guide for creative and layout styles.
- Output now includes a "Text Design Prompt" field with recommended style, enhancing integration with AI design tools.
- Added a new reference file: `references/text-design-prompts-guide.md` to support prompt generation.
- All other naming and evaluation workflows remain unchanged.

**Summary: Major update to professionalize and expand cross-cultural naming capabilities.**

- Expanded scope: Skill now covers brand strategy, legal compliance, industry standards, and cross-cultural/localization naming.
- Enhanced workflow: Added structured brand positioning analysis and six-dimension evaluation for each naming proposal.
- New templates and references: Introduced materials covering naming methodologies, tools, rules (industry, trademark, digital), cross-lingual detection, and risk assessment.
- Improved special cases handling: Added procedures for zero-information, contradictory requirements, and sensitive content filtering.
- More comprehensive outputs: Each name now includes full semantic, cultural, phonetic, brand, cross-language, and protectability analysis.
- Audience guidance: Quick-start templates and scenario guidance help users clarify and select naming needs.

Initial release of the "naming-expert" skill — a professional, cross-cultural naming engine.

- Supports structured requirement analysis and multi-dimensional creative name generation.
- Applicable for brand, product, company, personal, pet, IP, project, online handle, and domain naming needs.
- Delivers 3–5 name proposals per request, each with semantic, cultural, and phonetic analysis.
- Includes workflow for iterating based on user feedback and optimization tips (style match, trademark/domain check, cross-lingual ambiguity).
- Responds in Chinese, English, or bilingually according to user's language.
